tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Desilting of Kadekar Wetwell, repair of Barscreen and other development work in MCC limits

itemList.description: Dewatering of the accumulated sewage collection chamber partition at the Kadekar Wetwell shall be carried out using heavy-duty sewage dewatering pumps of suitable capacity, along with all necessary suction and delivery hoses, generators, fuel, operators, standby arrangements, and allied equipment to ensure safe, continuous, and uninterrupted pumping operations during the maintenance period. The scope of work shall include providing and fixing temporary barricades, stop logs, fabricated temporary gates, or other suitable isolation arrangements at the incoming sewer connections to prevent inflow of sewage from the sewerage network into the chamber during execution of the work, thereby enabling complete isolation of the inlet chamber for cleaning and maintenance activities. After complete dewatering of the chamber, the work shall include removal of accumulated silt, sludge, grit, floating waste, debris, and other deposited materials from the incoming sewage flow path and inlet portion manually as well as by mechanical means, including collection, loading, transportation, unloading, and safe disposal of the removed waste materials at approved dumping locations as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The scope shall further include thorough cleaning and washing of the inlet chamber, inspection of the chamber structure for any damages, leakages, or defects, and carrying out minor rectification works wherever required to ensure proper operational condition. The work also includes installation, testing, and commissioning of new gate valves supplied departmentally or otherwise for effective control and regulation of sewage inflow into the chamber, including fixing of all necessary fittings, flanges, nuts, bolts, rubber gaskets, supports, guide arrangements, cutting, welding, alignment, anchoring, and connection works required for proper installation and smooth operation of the valves. The contractor shall provide all labour, machinery, tools and tackles, safety equipment, temporary lighting arrangements, dewatering accessories, and all allied civil, mechanical, and operational works necessary for successful completion of the work, strictly in accordance with departmental specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Removal of silt deposited inside the wetwell sewage partition shall be carried out using electric hoist arrangements, mechanical handling equipment, labour, and all necessary tools and tackles to ensure proper cleaning and smooth functioning of the wetwell system. The scope of work shall include lowering and lifting of accumulated silt, sludge, grit, floating materials, and other obstructions from the wetwell compartments, collection and safe disposal of the removed waste materials at approved locations as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge, and thorough cleaning of the wetwell area to maintain uninterrupted sewage flow and operational efficiency. The work shall also include repairs and maintenance of the bar screen assembly installed in the incoming sewage channel, comprising dismantling, cleaning, rectification, alignment, welding, replacement of damaged or corroded components, tightening of fasteners, lubrication of moving parts, servicing of guide channels, lifting mechanisms, support structures, and repainting with anti-corrosive coating wherever required to ensure proper screening of incoming sewage. The scope further includes carrying out all allied developmental and maintenance works connected with the wetwell system, including minor civil, mechanical, and electrical rectification works necessary for safe and efficient operation, transportation of men and materials, provision of safety equipment, dewatering arrangements wherever necessary, and completion of the entire work in accordance with departmental specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
